text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A land where sparkling celebrities gather...
"Dubai"—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The country of my dreams! And the race held there...
is super-duper celebrity-style, of course!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I want to run in Dubai's
sparkle-filled races too――and win!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
See?
Isn't it a suuuper wonderful dream?

I signed a trainer contract with Vivlos
for the Twinkle Series.
The very next day—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie!
Morning♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What is it?
choice_data_list: Could you maybe stop calling me that after all?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?
You don't want to~!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ......Do you really not want to?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right...?
choice_data_list: It's not that I disliked it, it's just...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So you don't mind, right?
Then it's fine, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're "Trainy-poo"♡
It's decided!

...Vivlos is the youngest of three sisters.
Perhaps due to that position, she is very good at acting spoiled...
I'll need to handle her skillfully moving forward.
choice_data_list: For now, let's get right into training today. Good to be working with you.
For now, let's get right into training today. I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm looking forward to working with you!
I've been super excited for this.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "What should we do first? For starters..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we build our own
private gym or something?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The ones at Tracen Academy are amazing too, but
something way, waaay more incredible!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's super spacious, packed with all the latest machines,
and the walls are entirely made of glass!
What if the outside is a massive desert or somethin' alongside it!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa,
so totally high class♪

Vivlos yearns for "celebrity" things.
She loves glamorous, sparkling things,
and the reason for that... lay in her dream.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm gonna go to Dubai someday! Gotta step up my celebrity vibes, y'know?
In Dubai, there is a day when international GⅠ races are held. On that day, GⅠs across various categories take place, drawing Umamusume from all over the world in massive excitement.

Before signing our contract, she told me
that running in that Dubai race was her dream.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy!
Can we set up a private gym~?
choice_data_list: ...The academy's gym is top-tier celebrity class!
...The academy's gym is top-tier celebrity class!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oh? Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess so!
In that case, I'll pass on the gym.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: For now, at least♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And so, before we head to that fancy celeb gym,
there are some people I want to introduce you to!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
First up, we have some folks
you know very well, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
hello.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hello.
The ones who appeared were Vivlos's older sisters... Verxina and Cheval Grand.

The eldest sister, Verxina.
She once dominated the Tiara route
and was a magnificent Umamusume who won back-to-back GⅠs.

The middle sister, Cheval Grand.
She debuted last year and is working hard to produce results, aiming for a graded stakes victory.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
These are my beloved big sisters! ♡
Hey, hey, aren't they both super great?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Today, on top of that!
I'm gonna introduce some people very dear to me!

Led by Vivlos and the others, we arrived at... their family home.
Waiting there was—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hello!
I'm Viwbrus' mother~♪

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm Vivlos's father!
Welcome, Trainer!

A youthful, radiant Umamusume and
a well-built, refreshing-looking man... Vivlos's
parents stood close together in loving harmony.
Both of Vivlos's parents are publicly famous. I've seen them on TV many times.
Her father is an active baseball player, renowned as a big-hearted, open-minded family man devoted to his wife.

Her mother had once been an idol-like Umamusume.
Though she never won a graded stakes race,
she commanded an undeniable presence in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Papa~? For Trainer's cup, I think the one on the far right would be best, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, Trainy!
Don't stare at Mom so much, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dad, tell them
they can't do that too~!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Aww, Vivlos is just so darn cute!
That's our daughter for you! Who's a good girl, yes you are, yes you are!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: S-Stop it, that's embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hasn't it always been like this?
It's a little late to bring that up now.

It seems Vivlos's family gets along wonderfully.
Her friendly, sociable personality was likely nurtured
within such warmth.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha! Well, above all,
I'm just glad everyone's doing so well!
choice_data_list: Haven't you seen each other lately?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You see, the kids are all living in
the dorms now, right? On top of that, both my wife
and I have our own jobs, so...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"It's been, like, SO long
since we all hung out together like this!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Since Vivlos is also debuting,
just like with the older two,
the time we get to see each other will likely decrease even more.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm counting on you, Trainer!
Please take good care of Vivlos!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey! You know what,
there's something I want Mommy and Daddy to hear!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know that I want
to go to Dubai, right?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Of course~ Ever since that family trip we went on
when you all were little... you've just been head over heels, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna live in Dubai!" she said.
I remember so well how she made such a huge fuss about it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. This time, I'm going to aim for
the Dubai race with my own strength!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! That's an amazing goal!
I'm rooting for you, Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thanks♡
Though before that... there's one more goal I have.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —I'm taking the Triple Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To avenge Big Sis...
I'm going to take the Triple Tiara!
"The major races of the Classic Year are divided into the Classic Triple Crown route, and—the Tiara route."

The latter is the glamorous route consisting of the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho...
An Umamusume who wins all three is hailed as a Triple Tiara victor—

Only four have ever conquered that steep path
and claimed the honor of the Tiara.
And one of them is—

—Gentildonna.
The strongest Umamusume who kept pushing Verxina to second place along that year's Tiara road.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Vivlos.
Are you really sure about this? Doing it for my sake, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing!
After all, I love you so much, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Besides, isn't a Triple Tiara Umamusume
super high-class? It feels so Dubai♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, we'll simply support
whatever decision Vivlos makes."

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Vivlos!
No matter where we are,
we'll always be cheering on your dream!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I'll do my best~!

And so, after explaining the dream
to the family once more—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —And now you want food again~?
choice_data_list: It's because you're a little too slender.
Because you're a little too slender.

text_block_list.text:
Compared to other girls of her generation, Vivlos has a rather frail build.
Alongside full-scale training, conditioning her body is essential.
choice_data_list: Let's build a body that can handle an overseas campaign!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
An overseas campaign...
Right, because I'm going to Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
I'll eat up!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a super tough, super amazing Umamusume!
And make aaall my dreams come true! ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainy!
...Time to dig in!

And so, alongside the cheerful and friendly
Umamusume, Vivlos...
Our challenge in the Twinkle Series began!
